Security and privacy

## Private by design.

Draftera holds sensitive records, so control and privacy are built in, not bolted on.

### Separate, isolated spaces

Personal and business stay fully separate in one account. Nothing bleeds between them.

### Links you control

Share with tracked links that expire or can be revoked anytime, with an activity trail of every open.

Nothing is public. You decide exactly what each person is allowed to see.

### Locked to you

Open the app on your phone with Face ID, so only you get into your vault.
